plan.notes: Source: official Cal Poly Humboldt 2025-2026 Catalog, 'Zoology, B.S. MAP' (Major Academic Plan). https://catalog.humboldt.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=14&poid=8500&returnto=2302 MAPs are suggested 4-year pathways ('guide - not a rule'); GE, American Institutions, DCG, GWAR, and Elective-or-Minor slots are chosen by the student with an advisor. total_credits (120) is the exact sum of the encoded slots. 'or' options are encoded at the source lower bound per collection convention (MATH 105=3 not MATH 109=4; PHYX 118=1 not PHYX 107=4); each choice is documented in its choice_note. BOT 105 is printed as 5 units in Semester 1 of this MAP (4 units in other MAPs); transcribed as printed so the semester reconciles to its 15-unit header. Per-slot prerequisites are not published on MAP pages, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
